name: David Riessner
headline: Managing Director at Jefferies
location: New York City, United States of America
summary:
Healthcare investment banker with over 20 years of execution and coverage experience. Advising corporations, financial sponsors and family offices, David's experience comprises a broad variety of deals across M&A, Restructuring and IPO advisory situations, often cross border in nature. David has worked with clients in Europe, North America and Asia, with a particular emphasis on the healthcare, chemicals and general industrials sectors.

David has advised on over 35 successfully closed transactions with a combined Enterprise Value of over $220 billion.

He specialises in M&A advisory assignments with a strong emphasis on structuring, valuation and strategic impact, as well as their implementation through sell-side, buy-side, capital markets and leveraged transactions. Further experience includes evaluating investment opportunities and venture portfolios for both primary and secondary venture capital and private equity investments.

Fluent in English, German and French

positions.title: Senior Vice President
positions.description: Member of Jefferies’ global Healthcare Investment Banking Group. Leading deal teams on domestic and cross-border buy-side, sell-side and strategic advisory mandates on behalf of both corporate clients and financial sponsors.

positions.title: Vice President (M&A)
positions.description: Advised on broad range of healthcare services and biopharma buy-side, sell-side and strategic advisory mandates on behalf of large-cap and and mid-cap corporate clients in North America, Asia and Europe. Announced landmark deals included the the sale of Aetna to CVS Health, Aetna on the acquisition of Humana (lapsed), the sale of Ariad Pharmaceuticals to Takeda, and the sale of Cardinal Health Chinese Distribution business to Shanghai Pharma.
